GO", "sp_all": "CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_adReferrals_all] (@pjsonfile VARCHAR(MAX))
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON;
BEGIN
    DECLARE @companyId INT;
    DECLARE @startDate DATE;
    DECLARE @endDate DATE;
    DECLARE @sourceId NVARCHAR(64);
    DECLARE @onlyNew BIT;

    SELECT
        @companyId = TRY_CONVERT(INT, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.companyId')),
        @startDate = TRY_CONVERT(DATE, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.startDate')),
        @endDate = TRY_CONVERT(DATE, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.endDate')),
        @sourceId = JSON_VALUE(value, '$.sourceId'),
        @onlyNew = TRY_CONVERT(BIT, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.onlyNew'))
    FROM OPENJSON(@pjsonfile, '$.adReferrals');

    -- Default to last 30 days if no dates provided
    IF @startDate IS NULL AND @endDate IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SET @endDate = CAST(GETDATE() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'Central Standard Time' AS DATE); -- Hermosillo (UTC-7, no DST)
        SET @startDate = DATEADD(day, -30, @endDate);
    END
    ELSE IF @startDate IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SET @startDate = '2000-01-01'; -- Effectively no start date
    END
    ELSE IF @endDate IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SET @endDate = '2099-12-31'; -- Effectively no end date
    END
    
    -- Convert Hermosillo dates to UTC for comparison with referredAt (which is UTC)
    DECLARE @startDateUtc DATETIME = SWITCHOFFSET(CONVERT(DATETIMEOFFSET, @startDate), '-07:00');
    DECLARE @endDateUtc DATETIME = SWITCHOFFSET(CONVERT(DATETIMEOFFSET, DATEADD(day, 1, @endDate)), '-07:00'); -- End of day for endDate

    SELECT TOP 200
        ar.adReferralId,
        ar.companyId,
        ISNULL(ar.channelId, 0) AS channelId,
        ISNULL(cbr.branchId, 0) AS branchId,
        ISNULL(cbr.branchName, '') AS branchName,
        ISNULL(ar.customerPhone, '') AS customerPhone,
        ISNULL(ar.clientId, 0) AS clientId,
        ISNULL(ar.isNewCustomer, 0) AS isNewCustomer,
        ISNULL(ar.source, '') AS source,
        ISNULL(ar.sourceType, '') AS sourceType,
        ISNULL(ar.sourceId, '') AS sourceId,
        ISNULL(ar.sourceUrl, '') AS sourceUrl,
        ISNULL(ar.headline, '') AS headline,
        -- Do not return 'body' or 'ctwaClid' as per PRD hints
        ISNULL(ar.mediaType, '') AS mediaType,
        ar.referredAt,
        ar.created_At
    FROM dbo.adReferrals ar
    LEFT JOIN dbo.whatsappChannels wc ON ar.channelId = wc.channelId
    LEFT JOIN dbo.companiesBranches cbr ON wc.branchId = cbr.branchId AND wc.companyId = cbr.companyId
    WHERE ar.companyId = @companyId
      AND ar.referredAt >= @startDateUtc
      AND ar.referredAt < @endDateUtc
      AND (@sourceId IS NULL OR ar.sourceId = @sourceId)
      AND (@onlyNew IS NULL OR ar.isNewCustomer = @onlyNew)
    ORDER BY ar.referredAt DESC
    WHERE [companyId] = @companyId
    FOR JSON AUTO, ROOT('adReferrals');
END;

GO", "sp_adReferrals_performance": "CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_adReferrals_performance]
    @pjsonfile VARCHAR(MAX)
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON;
BEGIN TRY
    DECLARE @companyId INT;
    DECLARE @startDate DATE;
    DECLARE @endDate DATE;
    DECLARE @attributionDays INT;

    SELECT
        @companyId = TRY_CONVERT(INT, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.companyId')),
        @startDate = TRY_CONVERT(DATE, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.startDate')),
        @endDate = TRY_CONVERT(DATE, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.endDate')),
        @attributionDays = ISNULL(TRY_CONVERT(INT, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.attributionDays')), 14) -- Default to 14 days
    FROM OPENJSON(@pjsonfile, '$.adReferralPerformance');

    -- Validate mandatory fields
    IF @companyId IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT '{"error":"companyId is mandatory"}' AS jsonResult;
        RETURN;
    END

    -- Default to last 30 days if no dates provided (Hermosillo time)
    IF @startDate IS NULL AND @endDate IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SET @endDate = CAST(GETDATE() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'Central Standard Time' AS DATE);
        SET @startDate = DATEADD(day, -30, @endDate);
    END
    ELSE IF @startDate IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SET @startDate = '2000-01-01'; -- Effectively no start date
    END
    ELSE IF @endDate IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SET @endDate = '2099-12-31'; -- Effectively no end date
    END

    -- Get the earliest referredAt for dataSince
    DECLARE @dataSince DATETIME;
    SELECT TOP 1 @dataSince = ar.referredAt
    FROM dbo.adReferrals ar
    WHERE ar.companyId = @companyId
    ORDER BY ar.referredAt ASC;

    DECLARE @dataSinceHermosillo DATE = NULL;
    IF @dataSince IS NOT NULL
        SET @dataSinceHermosillo = CAST(@dataSince AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'Central Standard Time' AS DATE);

    -- Convert Hermosillo dates to UTC for comparison with referredAt and reservations.created_At (which are UTC)
    DECLARE @startPeriodUtc DATETIME = SWITCHOFFSET(CONVERT(DATETIMEOFFSET, @startDate), '-07:00');
    DECLARE @endPeriodUtc DATETIME = SWITCHOFFSET(CONVERT(DATETIMEOFFSET, DATEADD(day, 1, @endDate)), '-07:00'); -- End of day for endDate

    -- CTE for the latest headline and sourceUrl for each sourceId within the company
    WITH LatestAdDetails AS (
        SELECT
            ar.sourceId,
            ar.headline,
            ar.sourceUrl,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ar.companyId, ar.sourceId ORDER BY ar.referredAt DESC) as rn
        FROM dbo.adReferrals ar
        WHERE ar.companyId = @companyId
    ),
    -- CTE for all ad referrals in the period with normalized phone numbers
    PeriodReferrals AS (
        SELECT
            ar.adReferralId,
            ar.companyId,
            ar.clientId,
            ar.isNewCustomer,
            ar.sourceId,
            ar.referredAt,
            RIGHT(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(ar.customerPhone, '+', ''), ' ', ''), '-', ''), 10) AS NormalizedCustomerPhone10
        FROM dbo.adReferrals ar
        WHERE ar.companyId = @companyId
          AND ar.referredAt >= @startPeriodUtc
          AND ar.referredAt < @endPeriodUtc
    ),
    -- Determine the first touch ad for each customer within the period
    FirstTouchPerCustomer AS (
        SELECT
            pr.NormalizedCustomerPhone10,
            pr.clientId,
            MIN(pr.adReferralId) AS FirstAdReferralId,
            MIN(pr.referredAt) AS FirstReferredAt,
            (SELECT TOP 1 sourceId FROM PeriodReferrals WHERE adReferralId = MIN(pr.adReferralId)) AS AttributedSourceId,
            (SELECT TOP 1 isNewCustomer FROM PeriodReferrals WHERE adReferralId = MIN(pr.adReferralId)) AS AttributedIsNewCustomer
        FROM PeriodReferrals pr
        GROUP BY pr.NormalizedCustomerPhone10, pr.clientId
    ),
    -- Join with client and determine attribution window end
    AttributedCustomers AS (
        SELECT
            ft.NormalizedCustomerPhone10,
            ft.clientId AS AttributedClientId,
            ft.FirstAdReferralId,
            ft.FirstReferredAt,
            ft.AttributedSourceId,
            ft.AttributedIsNewCustomer,
            DATEADD(day, @attributionDays, ft.FirstReferredAt) AS AttributionWindowEndUtc
        FROM FirstTouchPerCustomer ft
    )
    SELECT
        (SELECT
            CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @startDate, 120) AS startDate,
            CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @endDate, 120) AS endDate
        FOR JSON PATH, WITHOUT_ARRAY_WRAPPER) AS period,
        @attributionDays AS attributionDays,
        (SELECT
            COUNT(DISTINCT ac.NormalizedCustomerPhone10) AS customers,
            COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ac.AttributedIsNewCustomer = 1 THEN ac.NormalizedCustomerPhone10 END) AS newCustomers,
            COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.reservationId IS NOT NULL THEN ac.NormalizedCustomerPhone10 END) AS booked,
            COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN i.incomeId IS NOT NULL THEN ac.NormalizedCustomerPhone10 END) AS bought,
            ISNULL(SUM(DISTINCT i.total), 0.00) AS salesAfterChat
        FROM AttributedCustomers ac
        LEFT JOIN dbo.clients cl ON ac.AttributedClientId = cl.clientId AND cl.companyId = @companyId
        LEFT JOIN dbo.reservations r ON cl.clientId = r.clientId AND r.companyId = @companyId
            AND r.source = 'whatsapp' AND r.status <> 'cancelled'
            AND r.created_At >= ac.FirstReferredAt AND r.created_At < ac.AttributionWindowEndUtc
        LEFT JOIN dbo.income i ON cl.clientId = i.clientId AND i.companyId = @companyId
            -- income.paymentDate is Hermosillo local. Convert referral window to Hermosillo for comparison.
            AND i.paymentDate >= CAST(ac.FirstReferredAt AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'Central Standard Time' AS DATE)
            AND i.paymentDate < CAST(ac.AttributionWindowEndUtc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'Central Standard Time' AS DATE)
        FOR JSON PATH, WITHOUT_ARRAY_WRAPPER) AS totals,
        ISNULL((
            SELECT
                ISNULL(ac.AttributedSourceId, 'null') AS sourceId,
                ISNULL(lad.headline, 'Anuncio sin identificar') AS headline,
                ISNULL(lad.sourceUrl, '') AS sourceUrl,
                COUNT(DISTINCT ac.NormalizedCustomerPhone10) AS customers,
                COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ac.AttributedIsNewCustomer = 1 THEN ac.NormalizedCustomerPhone10 END) AS newCustomers,
                COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.reservationId IS NOT NULL THEN ac.NormalizedCustomerPhone10 END) AS booked,
                COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN i.incomeId IS NOT NULL THEN ac.NormalizedCustomerPhone10 END) AS bought,
                ISNULL(SUM(DISTINCT i.total), 0.00) AS salesAfterChat,
                MIN(ac.FirstReferredAt) AS firstAt,
                MAX(ac.FirstReferredAt) AS lastAt
            FROM AttributedCustomers ac
            LEFT JOIN LatestAdDetails lad ON ac.AttributedSourceId = lad.sourceId AND lad.rn = 1
            LEFT JOIN dbo.clients cl ON ac.AttributedClientId = cl.clientId AND cl.companyId = @companyId
            LEFT JOIN dbo.reservations r ON cl.clientId = r.clientId AND r.companyId = @companyId
                AND r.source = 'whatsapp' AND r.status <> 'cancelled'
                AND r.created_At >= ac.FirstReferredAt AND r.created_At < ac.AttributionWindowEndUtc
            LEFT JOIN dbo.income i ON cl.clientId = i.clientId AND i.companyId = @companyId
                AND i.paymentDate >= CAST(ac.FirstReferredAt AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'Central Standard Time' AS DATE)
                AND i.paymentDate < CAST(ac.AttributionWindowEndUtc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'Central Standard Time' AS DATE)
            GROUP BY ac.AttributedSourceId, lad.headline, lad.sourceUrl
            ORDER BY customers DESC
            FOR JSON PATH
        ), '[]') AS ads,
        CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @dataSinceHermosillo, 120) AS dataSince
    FOR JSON PATH, WITHOUT_ARRAY_WRAPPER;

END TRY
BEGIN CATCH
    SELECT '{"error":"' + REPLACE(ERROR_MESSAGE(), '"', '''') + '"}' AS jsonResult;
END CATCH;
